                      Table "examples.authors"
  Column   |     Type     |     Collation      | Nullable | Default 
-----------+--------------+--------------------+----------+---------

Indexes:
    "PRIMARY" PRIMARY KEY, BTREE
Referenced by:
    TABLE "books" CONSTRAINT "books_ibfk_1" FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES authors(author_id)


-- \d books
                       Table "examples.books"

-----------+--------------+--------------------+----------+---------

Indexes:

    "author_id" BTREE
Foreign-key constraints:
